answer: A protocol can make each agent earn reputation through a time-locked stake that is slashed when independent audits expose duplicate identities. An attacker must fund and immobilize a separate bond for every Sybil persona, then keep each one honest through the lock period; multiplying accounts therefore multiplies capital cost and forfeited yield. A summit of trust comes only after costly, verifiable work, not a zephyr of fabricated profiles or a jetty built from free accounts.
